Q6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SETTLE
THREE CELL TYPES ARE BEING JOINED and no amount of statistics repairs that:
burst kinetics   Larsson 2019, human ortholog panel (1,609 genes)
chromatin        GM12878 lymphoblastoid, in situ Hi-C, hg19, 25 kb
abundance        Schwanhausser 2011, MOUSE NIH3T3 fibroblasts
A correlation across those three is a correlation across three biologies. It can support a DIRECTIONAL claim -- frequency versus size -- because both factors come from
the same table and are compared against the same chromatin vector. It cannot support a quantitative rate prediction for any one cell.
Also untested here: elongation SPEED per gene (Fuchs 2015's other axis), tRNA and ribosome supply, and whether the 40% pausing figure from mouse ESC/MEF transfers.

corrections.what_the_gate_said: partial Spearman given abundance, non-zero at p < 0.01
corrections.what_it_should_have_said: POSITIVE partial Spearman given abundance at p < 0.01
corrections.why: the chromatin hypothesis predicts that more contact density means MORE transcription. The observed partial is -0.1412 (p=0.0050): more contact density associates with LOWER measured rate. A two-sided gate on a directional hypothesis let a wrong-signed effect register as a PASS.
corrections.effect: Q5's PASS is WITHDRAWN as evidence for the chromatin layer. The number stands; the interpretation does not. This is the same class of error as loop 150's R3 -- the gate ran correctly and measured the wrong thing.
corrections.note: the partial (-0.1412) is LARGER in magnitude than the raw (-0.0833), which is a suppression pattern and a further reason not to read it as a mechanistic result at n=635 across three cell types.

corrections.what_was_missing: the loop printed 'all four corrections' at the OPTIMISTIC proteome (1e10) and reported the budget closing at 22.0%, without printing the conservative-proteome combination that R5 actually gated on.
corrections.honest_statement: fixing the two arithmetic errors alone brings R5 from 142.6% to 66.0% at the SAME conservative proteome it gated on, so the recorded FAIL was substantially an arithmetic artifact. But adding the Min-2011 pausing correction returns it to 110.0% at that proteome. The budget closes only if the proteome is at or above ~5e9 molecules. R5's verdict is therefore NOT settled either way -- it is hostage to the proteome census, exactly as its own sweep implied.

q3_restated.reading: Larsson 2019 reports enhancers controlling burst FREQUENCY and core promoters controlling SIZE. On this contact map the only feature with any signal, TSS insulation, tracks burst SIZE. Either the Hi-C contact features are not measuring enhancer-promoter communication, or the prediction does not transfer across the three-cell-type join. Both are live and this loop cannot separate them.
